jobs.title: Software Engineer, Test Infrastructure (AI DevEx)
jobs.description:
About Sift

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. We turn high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical machines: rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, and defense platforms. Founded by former SpaceX engineers, we are building the review and analysis layer for the AI era of physical systems.

About The Role

Sift is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and own the developer infrastructure and testing environments that enable our engineers to ship software faster and with greater confidence.

You'll design systems that allow engineers to spin up complete, production-like environments on demand to test changes, simulate real-world workloads, and validate correctness. As AI coding agents become increasingly integrated into development workflows, you'll build the infrastructure that enables these agents to independently test, debug, and validate the code they produce.

Sift processes high-volume telemetry from complex hardware systems, making realistic testing environments particularly challenging. This is a foundational, high-ownership opportunity to architect and scale the infrastructure that powers how we develop, test, and ship software.

In This Role, You'll

Design and build infrastructure that provisions isolated, production-like testing environments on demand, enabling engineers to validate changes against Sift's full application stack.
Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, build systems, and deployment automation to make testing environments fast, reliable, and cost-efficient.
Develop infrastructure that supports diverse testing workloads, including integration testing, correctness validation, load testing, and performance testing.
Build tooling for realistic data generation and user behavior simulation to validate software under production-like conditions.
Enable AI coding agents to interact with testing environments, execute tests, and validate code changes autonomously.
Partner closely with engineering teams to understand developer needs, eliminate bottlenecks, and improve development velocity and software quality.

The Skillset You'll Bring

6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience in developer infrastructure, test infrastructure, platform engineering, or developer tooling.
Deep hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, build systems, and deploying applications to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Experience building and automating developer infrastructure, deployment systems, or testing environments, with an understanding of scalability, performance, and reliability.
Experience developing or optimizing CI/CD pipelines and automating infrastructure provisioning and deployments.
Strong software engineering and programming skills, preferably in Go or Python.
Ability to balance infrastructure performance, environment fidelity, reliability, and cost.
Strong collaboration skills and a developer-focused mindset, with experience building tools that improve engineering productivity.

Bonus Points

Experience building ephemeral or on-demand development and testing environments.
Load testing, performance testing, or distributed test execution.
Browser automation and end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright or Cypress.
Building sandboxed execution environments or infrastructure supporting AI coding agents.
Working on developer infrastructure at a fast-scaling technology company, cloud platform, or compute provider.

Engineering At SIFT

You'll have the opportunity to help evolve and scale our platform because we're still in the early stages of building the product. Relevant technologies include:

Web frontend & backend: ECharts, Go, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Protobuf, Radix, React, Redux, and TypeScript
Data: Arrow, DataFusion, Flink, Parquet, and Rust
Infrastructure: Argo CD, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Grafana, Kubernetes, Kustomize, Linux, Prometheus, and Terragrunt

Location:

Sift’s headquarters is in Marina Del Rey, CA
(Next to LAX). We collaborate in person
twice a week—on Mondays and Thursdays
—and come together for a full week every two months. We are open to relocating candidates to LA
or working from our San Francisco
office for the right candidate.

Salary range: $180,000 - $230,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.

Eligibility

U.S. Person Required
: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.

Job Description:

GDIT is seeking a Software Test Automation Engineer to support a mission-critical software application within the NCE Testing Organization (NTO) in Springfield, Virginia.

Working alongside developers and an existing tester, you will build an initial automated testing framework, develop and maintain regression tests, create effective test cases, and improve how the team validates software changes.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on test engineer who can move between manual and automated testing, write or modify test scripts, and take initiative in establishing practical, repeatable testing practices. Establish and implement an automated testing framework appropriate for the application's architecture and technology stack.

Active TS/SCI clearance with the required polygraph.
Five or more years of experience in software testing, quality assurance, test engineering, or a related discipline.
Hands-on experience creating, executing, and documenting software test cases.
Practical experience developing or implementing automated tests using a programming or scripting language.
Experience designing and executing regression tests for software applications.
Ability to translate requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria into effective test scenarios.
Experience identifying, documenting, tracking, and retesting software defects.
Ability to collaborate effectively with software developers and other technical team members.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
Ability to work on-site five days per week in Springfield, Virginia.
U.S. citizenship, as required for the position and customer environment.

Experience introducing automated testing into a software program that previously relied primarily on manual testing.
Experience building an initial automation framework or establishing a maintainable automated regression suite.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help build, scale, and improve the data infrastructure at the heart of Chartmetric. Our customers depend on the data that we collect, process, and analyze from music streaming platforms, social networks, radio, charts, and more to make important business decisions, and our new AI products create even greater opportunities to make it useful.

In this hands-on engineering role, you’ll work closely with our data engineering, backend, and product teams and design reliable data pipelines, investigate the underlying causes of failures, improve processing performance, and build better solutions to make our infrastructure more scalable and cost-efficient.

We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding how systems actually work, challenges existing assumptions, and takes pride in making complex data infrastructure simpler, faster, and more reliable.

Build and optimize data pipelines. Design, maintain, and scale reliable systems for ingesting, transforming, and processing large volumes of data from diverse sources.
Improve performance and reliability. Identify bottlenecks, optimize queries and storage, and build monitoring and validation systems to maintain data quality and prevent recurring failures.
Own data infrastructure. Improve databases and cloud infrastructure, leveraging technologies such as PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, and AWS to support growing data volumes efficiently.
Power analytics and AI products. Build the data foundations behind Chartmetric’s dashboards, APIs, and AI-native experiences, including Chartmetric Flow.
Solve complex technical problems. Debug production issues, investigate root causes, and develop durable solutions in collaboration with backend, product, and data engineering teams.
Drive engineering excellence. Use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity while contributing to code reviews, documentation, best practices, and team knowledge sharing.
This position is hybrid, in our San Mateo or New York office 3–4 days a week

Qualifications

2–4 years of experience building production data pipelines, preferably in high-volume consumer or entertainment industries
Strong Python and SQL, with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow (or a similar orchestrator), a columnar warehouse such as ClickHouse or Snowflake, and AWS. Experience with modern analytical databases, cloud infrastructure, and orchestration tools is particularly valuable.
Experience building and running pipelines that handle millions of records a day, including messy third-party APIs (rate limits, retries, changing schemas)
Strong communication skills, able to work well with engineers across different disciplines. You're comfortable explaining technical tradeoffs, challenging assumptions constructively, and collaborating with a distributed team.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Thrives in dynamic startup environments with rapidly evolving requirements and tight delivery timelines
Bonus: Experience with music industry data, streaming APIs, or social media analytics platforms

Competitive salary and equity package
Stipends for health & wellness, streaming services, live music events, and more
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
Real ownership of pipelines that customers use every day
Access to cutting-edge tools and technologies

We believe that great developer experiences lead to better products and happier teams. Our Data Engineering team operates as enablers and force multipliers, working collaboratively to remove friction from the development process. Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The Experience

Developer Workspaces runs the computers Slack engineers write code on - and more and more, the ones AI agents write code on. Every week, hundreds of engineers build and test Slack in the remote development environments we run on AWS and Kubernetes. Now we're building the next layer: fast, isolated sandboxes where coding agents can run a dev toolchain, open pull requests, and shut down when they're done.

If most of Slack's code is going to be written by agents, it'll be written on infrastructure this team owns.

We're a small team with a lot of surface area. We're strong on backend engineering, and we need more depth in infrastructure and operations. That's this role. You'll own production systems early, carry the pager, and help decide how agents run safely at Slack.

Scale our AI sandbox fleet into something the whole company depends on - capacity planning, safe rollouts, image builds, and the alerts that tell us when it's breaking.

Build observability we can make decisions with - SLOs, dashboards, and logs that land where we can find them.

You've worked with Firecracker, KVM, or other virtualization.

You've worked on a developer productivity or platform team.

Working alongside developers and an existing tester, you will build an initial automated testing framework, develop and maintain regression tests, create effective test cases, and improve how the team validates software changes.

U.S. citizenship, as required for the position and customer environment.

Chartmetric is one of the music industry’s leading data analytics platforms, trusted by more than 8,000 customers, including major labels such as Universal, Sony, Warner, and Apple Music, management firms, and music professionals around the world. We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help build, scale, and improve the data infrastructure at the heart of Chartmetric. Our customers depend on the data that we collect, process, and analyze from music streaming platforms, social networks, radio, charts, and more to make important business decisions, and our new AI products create even greater opportunities to make it useful.

Build and optimize data pipelines. Design, maintain, and scale reliable systems for ingesting, transforming, and processing large volumes of data from diverse sources.

Power analytics and AI products. Build the data foundations behind Chartmetric’s dashboards, APIs, and AI-native experiences, including Chartmetric Flow.
Solve complex technical problems. Debug production issues, investigate root causes, and develop durable solutions in collaboration with backend, product, and data engineering teams.

This position is hybrid, in our San Mateo or New York office 3–4 days a week

Qualifications

2–4 years of experience building production data pipelines, preferably in high-volume consumer or entertainment industries
Strong Python and SQL, with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow (or a similar orchestrator), a columnar warehouse such as ClickHouse or Snowflake, and AWS. Experience with modern analytical databases, cloud infrastructure, and orchestration tools is particularly valuable.
Experience building and running pipelines that handle millions of records a day, including messy third-party APIs (rate limits, retries, changing schemas)
Strong communication skills, able to work well with engineers across different disciplines. You're comfortable explaining technical tradeoffs, challenging assumptions constructively, and collaborating with a distributed team.

Competitive salary and equity package
Stipends for health & wellness, streaming services, live music events, and more
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
Real ownership of pipelines that customers use every day
Access to cutting-edge tools and technologies

We believe that great developer experiences lead to better products and happier teams.
